description: For window cleaning, this inspection checklist records interior or exterior surfaces, screen and track work, hard-water treatment, ladder or lift plan, exclusions, and price. Its supporting evidence includes count verification, pre-existing damage photos, access assessment, completed panes, and unresolved stain or seal findings.

items: Scheduled interior and exterior panes are reconciled
Glass is checked for streaks, residue, and missed edges
Screens, tracks, sills, and requested detail work are complete
Pre-existing cracks, failed seals, frames, and hardware are recorded
Inaccessible or weather-deferred panes have a reason
Access points, furnishings, floors, and property security are restored

subtitle: Window Cleaning Inspection Checklist: window cleaning survey and service completion using window counts, interior or exterior surfaces, and count verification.
title: Window Cleaning Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during window cleaning survey and service completion when the window cleaning record must identify window counts, types, floors, screens, tracks, skylights, access, landscaping, and interior protection needs. Complete the applicable handoff for pane and screen check, furniture restoration, damage exception, customer walkthrough, and future-service note.
